sloka: स रामबाणैरभिविद्धगात्रो निशाचरेन्द्रः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः ।जगाम खेदं च समाजमध्ये क्रोधं च चक्रे सुभृशं तदानीम् ।। ६.१०४.३२ ।।
transliteration: sa rāmabāṇairabhividdhagātro niśācarendraḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ ।jagāma khedaṁ ca samājamadhye krodhaṁ ca cakre subhṛśaṁ tadānīm ।। 6.104.32 ।।

translations.english: His limbs pierced deep by Rama's arrows, his body wet with blood, that lord of the night-rangers, in the midst of his host, was then filled with weariness and with exceeding wrath.
